attacks.claim: The HIL matrix line reads "no C-wire power stealing", which is ambiguous. If power-stealing units are in the fleet, relay-open and reboot behaviour during install was not bench-verified on them.
attacks.evidence: HIL bench: conventional 1H/1C, 2-stage, heat pump + aux, no C-wire power stealing; rev B/C/D

attacks.claim: Stage-1 gates are statistically thin: 0.05% of about 6,100 units is roughly 3 events, and "not above baseline" has no stated test or per-stratum minimum. The paging alerts also do not cover HVAC fault codes or support contacts, so those gates rely on manual review.
attacks.evidence: boot-revert rate < 0.05% ... HVAC fault telemetry not above 4.7 baseline

attacks.claim: QA does not cover the 4.8→4.7→edit→4.8 round trip. The artifact designs this path (the cloud discards the stale v2 copy), but it is untested.
attacks.evidence: When a unit on 4.7 edits its schedule, the cloud discards the stale v2 copy; ABSENT: QA case for the round trip
